annotation.title_clean: Commission Implementing Decision (EU) 2019/1396 of 10 September 2019 laying down the rules for the application of Regulation (EU) 2017/745 of the European Parliament and of the Council as regards the designation of expert panels in the field of medical devices
annotation.title_en: Commission Implementing Decision (EU) 2019/1396 of 10 September 2019 laying down the rules for the application of Regulation (EU) 2017/745 as regards the designation of expert panels in the field of medical devices
annotation.venue: Official Journal of the European Union, L 234/23
named_instruments_referenced: EU In Vitro Diagnostic Medical Devices Regulation 2017/746
annotation.summary_en: EU Commission Implementing Decision designating expert panels under the Medical Devices Regulation (EU) 2017/745 and IVD Regulation 2017/746. It sets out how advisors are appointed, how panels are organised, the coordination committee and secretariat, conflict-of-interest, transparency and confidentiality rules, and how advisors are paid. It contains no AI or robotics content.
key_provisions_or_claims: Designates expert panels in 11 clinical areas plus one additional panel under Annex IX Section 5.1(c) MDR
Advisors appointed via public call for expression of interest for renewable three-year terms; central list of available experts
Coordination committee of Chairs and Vice-Chairs adopts common rules of procedure, publicly available
Advisors must declare interests, act independently, and keep information confidential
Advisors remunerated at EUR 450 per working day with task-based caps
